name: Compressor Staging Plausibility
applicable_contexts: sequencing strategy and part-load behavior unresolved
trigger_conditions: two or more compressors in service
physical_basis: Compressor part-load efficiency depends on staging order, VFD use, head pressure float, and economizer use. Wrong staging at low load wastes 20–40% of refrigeration kWh.
operational_basis: Default staging logic from commissioning rarely matches actual load profile; operators leave it alone.
financial_mechanism: Staging is a controls-grade fix with high ROI; missing it directs CAPEX toward replacement instead of tuning.
typical_false_assumption: All compressors run at high efficiency at any load.
hypothesis: Compressor staging may be misaligned with the actual load profile and should be falsified before replacement logic.
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: fixed-speed compressors at low load or head pressure not floating
falsification_conditions: VFD lead/lag with floating head pressure tuned
allowed_claim_language: Compressor staging is a plausible controls-grade loss-pattern requiring tuning evidence.
escalation_conditions: controls walk-through with refrigeration service provider
example_outputs: Compressor staging is a controls-grade falsification target before CAPEX.
tests: cold_chain bundle should activate this when multi-compressor staging strategy missing
